purpose: Classify the already-replicated H10S2-over-H10N1 10-80 Hz baseline-power asymmetry as approximately broadband/scale-like versus frequency-selective/nonuniform, using a new time sample that does not overlap the previous 12:00 UTC replication windows.

new_window_contract.independence_from_prior_replication: These windows begin at 00:00 UTC, twelve hours away from the prior frozen 12:00 UTC windows on the same listed dates; no waveform from these new windows was used to define the present thresholds.

frequency_contract.selection_basis: Exactly the diagnostic subbands already frozen in the earlier in-band positive-control protocol; no post-replication frequency search is introduced.

spectral_estimator.band_power: trapezoidal integration over each fully frozen interval

per_window_per_subband: raw S2-minus-N1 integrated-power ratio in dB
response-corrected S2-minus-N1 integrated-power ratio in dB
aggregate_per_subband: median raw S2-minus-N1 dB across complete paired windows
median corrected S2-minus-N1 dB across complete paired windows
shape_metrics: raw median-ratio spread = maximum subband median minus minimum subband median
corrected median-ratio spread = maximum subband median minus minimum subband median

classification_thresholds.engineering_interpretation: A <=3 dB spread means the median S2/N1 power ratio varies by no more than a factor of two in power across the three frozen subbands. This operationally defines approximately broadband/scale-like morphology; it is not a physical-cause claim.

claim_ceiling: BROADBAND_SCALE_LIKE means only that the replicated S2-over-N1 power offset is approximately uniform across the three frozen 10-80 Hz subbands on this independent time sample. It is compatible with more than one mechanism, including broadband environmental conditions, deployment/site effects, or an unmodeled multiplicative calibration/gain factor. FREQUENCY_SELECTIVE_OR_NONUNIFORM means only that the offset shape varies materially with frequency. Neither outcome identifies a physical cause, validates 119 Hz, or increases target evidence.
